already_played: Have you played on this server before?
presets_intro: Presets: activate a set of mods/vehicles and a map in one click.
confirm_apply_preset: Apply preset "{name}"? This will activate/deactivate mods, change the map and restart the server.
request_hint: Enter your exact BeamMP username. You must have played on the server at least once.
restart_not_configured: Restart not configured — see BEAMMP_AGENT_SERVICE in .env
consistency_desc: Verifies consistency between the database and files on disk.
import_desc: Scans Client/, inactive_mod/ and inactive_map/ directories and automatically creates database entries for every mod/map not yet registered. Extracts the name from info.json and a preview image from the zip.
cookie_desc: This site uses essential cookies for your session. No data is shared with third parties.
analyze_existing_desc: Re-reads mods already in the catalogue to extract practical information (brand, body style, drivetrain, map size…), without re-uploading anything.
analyze_result_remaining: more mods remain to analyze — run it again
catalog_subtitle: Everything this server offers. Items marked “In game” are active right now.
catalog_search: Search a map, a vehicle, a brand…
setup_intro: Three things and your server is ready. Everything can be changed later.
setup_server_dir_hint: The folder that holds (or will hold) BeamMP-Server.exe. The panel starts and watches it for you.
setup_download_hint: Latest official release (BeamMP GitHub), checksum verified.
setup_authkey_hint: Required: BeamMP-Server will not start without it. Create one in a minute at
setup_password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
panel_update_restarting: Installing… the panel restarts, the page reloads by itself.
panel_update_full: Version {v} requires downloading the full app again.
discord_webhooks_hint: One webhook per channel for this server. Left empty: the one from the .env file, otherwise the general webhook.
discord_texts_hint: Shared by all servers. Left empty: default text. Variables in braces are replaced.
earth_not_installed: The BeamNG.Earth plugin is not installed on this server (Resources/Server/BeamNGEarth).
earth_stopped: The plugin is not answering (server stopped, or a plugin too old to report its state)
earth_old_plugin: This plugin is too old to read the panel's settings: update BeamNG.Earth on the server.
earth_listing_earth: On the BeamNG.Earth list (the "BeamNG.Earth" tab of BeamMP's server browser), seen only by players with the app. The plugin keeps it off BeamMP's public list while it runs.
earth_listing_beammp: On BeamMP's public list, seen by every player, even without BeamNG.Earth (they can't play without the app).
earth_listing_direct: On no list: players join with Direct Connect and the address and port.
earth_listing_private_note: "Private server" in Configuration means something else with BeamNG.Earth: off (with an AuthKey), the server goes on the BeamNG.Earth list, not BeamMP's; on, it is on no list.
earth_listed_help: Off: a public server stays on BeamMP's public list instead of the BeamNG.Earth list.
earth_weather_real: Real (the live weather where each player is)
earth_sky_manual_note: A player who set Sky or Weather to Manual in BeamNG.Earth keeps their own.
earth_meet_help: A player joining farther than this from the others is sent to them (0: always).
earth_live_note: Applied within 2 seconds, no restart: time and weather change at once for connected players.
earth_store_help: The road plans players work out come here and go to whoever drives the same place later, even after a restart.
earth_needs_running: The plugin must be running to show the store.
earth_store_clear_confirm: Empty the whole shared store? Players work the roads out again on their first visit, and the store fills up again. Do it after an update that changes the plans' format.
earth_request_sent: Request sent: the plugin does it within 2 seconds.
earth_packs_help: Whole areas prepared in advance (.bnge files): the server sends them to players with the same BeamNG.Earth version, who then have nothing to work out.
earth_pack_not_loaded: Not served yet: click "Read the packs again".
earth_pack_added: Pack added: the plugin serves it within 2 seconds.
earth_pack_big_confirm: This pack is over 100 MB: through an address behind Cloudflare, the upload will fail. Then copy it into Resources/Server/BeamNGEarth/bake/ and click "Read the packs again". Upload anyway?
earth_packs_scp: Big pack: copy it straight into Resources/Server/BeamNGEarth/bake/ on the server, then click ↻.
earth_helper_help: Works out on this server the roads round the players before they get there, into the shared store. Held back: limited memory (if it runs short it stops, never BeamMP), CPU and disk only when the game server is not using them.
earth_helper_not_installed: The helper is not installed on this machine (Ansible role bnge-helper), or its supervisor is not answering.
earth_helper_oom: Last stop: memory limit reached (try 1 process)
earth_version_install_confirm: Install the new version of the mod and plugin? Settings, store and packs stay; the server must restart, and players need the app of the same version.
earth_version_restore_confirm: Put back the mod and plugin of version
earth_version_help: The mod (beamng_earth.zip) and the plugin come from the release's server zip, checksum verified. The replaced version is kept to go back.
earth_version_restart: Installed. Restart the server to apply it: connected players will be disconnected.
earth_helper_version_mismatch: The helper's version is not the mod's: what it works out serves no one. Run the bnge-helper Ansible role with the new version, or switch it off.
earth_map_empty: No one in the world right now.
earth_map_privacy: Seen by admins only: a player's place is theirs. Updated every 5 seconds; map © OpenStreetMap contributors, relayed by the panel.
